text: `npm test` runs Jest with the jest-expo preset. Native modules (expo-sqlite, expo-file-system, MapLibre) are mocked in jest.setup.ts.
E2E flows are Maestro YAML files in maestro/. Run `maestro test maestro/<flow>.yaml` against a dev build, not Expo Go.
MapLibre needs native code, so the app can't run in Expo Go. Use the dev client: `npx expo run:ios` or `npx expo run:android`.
Offline tiles are capped at 2 GB. tileStore evicts the least recently viewed region first and never a region used by an active trail recording.
SQLite migrations are numbered files in src/db/migrations/, applied at startup by src/db/migrate.ts. Never edit a shipped migration; add a new one.
Use isOnline() and useNetwork() from src/lib/network.ts. NetInfo's isConnected is true behind captive portals, so these helpers also ping our health endpoint.
Tile downloads must use expo-file-system background download tasks; iOS kills foreground downloads about 30 s after the app goes to the background.
The public OSM tile servers forbid bulk downloads. Offline packs must come from our own tile CDN (TILE_CDN_URL in app.config.ts).
Builds: `eas build --profile development` for the dev client, `--profile preview` for internal testers.
Offline mode is out of scope for v1; show a 'no connection' screen instead.
Maps use react-native-maps with Google tiles.
Push notifications go through the Expo push service; tokens are registered in src/features/notifications/register.ts after login.
In-app purchases (Pro plan) use RevenueCat. Test only with sandbox accounts, never a real Apple ID.
Translations live in src/i18n/locales/*.json and are pulled from the translation platform with `npm run i18n:pull`; don't edit de.json by hand.
Step counting uses HealthKit on iOS only; on Android the steps screen is hidden behind a Platform.OS check.
Style with StyleSheet.create and tokens from src/theme. No inline style objects in list items (FlatList re-render cost).
Branch from develop, not main; main only receives release merges.
Release: bump the version in app.config.ts, then `eas build --profile production --auto-submit`. Use `eas update` (OTA) only for JS-only fixes.
Trail recording writes a GPS point every 5 s to track_points; battery saver mode switches to 15 s.
Social sharing renders a trail card image with react-native-view-shot; Android needs the storage permission only below API 29.
`npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint` run in CI on every PR; fix errors locally first.
Store offline region metadata in AsyncStorage under the key offlineRegions.
